title: review_code
description: The Console review code: ONE record that holds a temporary, view-only way into the Console for a reviewer (see REVIEW_CODE_GUIDE.md). A super admin sets a code in the Access station (Sign-in box); it works for 24 hours; setting another code replaces it and restarts the 24 hours. Rules the schema cannot express: exactly one record exists (access_key is always current); only a super admin (or the admin key) may set it or ask its status, through two dedicated operations (set_review_code, review_code_status), never through the generic Console CRUD (the collection is blocked there); the code itself is never stored: only a salted hash; the hash and salt are never returned by any door; a sign-in by code acts as the view-only Global Inspector role and may not start a Discovery run; every field is set by the server only.
x_retention: Kept. The record is replaced in place when a new code is set; every change is also written to the activity log (hash and salt withheld). (A written policy only.)

access_key.description: Always current. It makes the one-record rule checkable, because ids are UUIDs. Required.

code_hash.description: A salted hash (HMAC-SHA256, hex) of the code. The code itself is never kept. Never returned by any door. Set by the server.

salt.description: Random text mixed into the hash, new for every code. Never returned by any door. Set by the server.

expires_at.description: When the code stops working (UTC): 24 hours after it was set. The server compares it with its own clock on every request. Set by the server.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was first created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who first created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the code was last set (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last set the code. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. Set by the server. Not used: the record is replaced, never deleted.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server. Not used.
